<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. I have manually compared their schedules to find all possible 30-minute meeting slots for next week.

Now, I need to communicate these findings to Brad through our shared workspace. My message should be clear and actionable for him. I will list all the common available slots for Priya and Marcus. I will then ask him to check the availability of Elena Soto and David Okafor for these times and to identify a suitable slot for all four partners. By providing a comprehensive list, he can efficiently find an opening. I will also suggest a course of action for him to take after he finds a suitable time.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

**Pinpointing Shared Availabilities**

I've compiled the final list, and now I'm prepared to pass this information along to Brad. My intention is for him to incorporate Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars for a comprehensive availability assessment. I'll propose he suggest the first slot that works for everyone.
